name: yunzai-guard
description: TRSS-Yunzai / 玖璃的进程接管、行为审计与函数完整性防护插件
author: Admilkk

scripts.test:platform: npm run build && node scripts/test.mjs platform
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node scripts/test.mjs all
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:web && node scripts/build-components.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/check-layers.mjs
scripts.build:runtime: node scripts/build-process-identity.mjs && node scripts/build-windows-broker.mjs && node scripts/build-bubblewrap.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-entrypoints.mjs && node scripts/build-protection.mjs && node scripts/build-sandbox.mjs
